comparability_rules: Do not sum or multiply source-local percentage improvements.
Keep thrust, thrust-to-power, thrust density and thrust-to-weight as separate metrics with explicit units.
Keep bare thruster, integrated platform and tethered system boundaries separate.
Keep article abstract transcriptions separate from full-article/raw-data transcriptions.
A missing condition remains null; do not infer it from another paper.
Treat online-ahead-of-issue modelling as a watchlist entry until publication status and model/measurement provenance are reconciled.
The Shibata 2026 multistage ducted optimization reports thrust per span in N/m; do not equate this with area-normalized thrust density in N/m^2.
Numerically optimized geometry is not an experimentally validated propulsion improvement; retain simulation and physical evidence classes.
ANEMONE 3D is a C++/MIT plasma solver for corona inception voltage and energy conversion efficiency; do not promote those outputs to complete neutral-flow or net-thrust validation.
Shibata and Nozaki's integral three-component plasma model has experimental comparisons for specified negative-corona geometries; retain the discharge-only validation boundary.
Booster-electrode thrust-density gains are voltage-specific comparisons against the same paper's no-booster baseline; the abstract transcription does not supply a metric unit.
Paired-anode force superposition is configuration-dependent; the orthogonal and horizontal results from one wire-cylinder study are not a universal array interaction law.
Switching-duty thrust control requires terminal-waveform, switching-loss and transient-response accounting before system efficiency or stability claims.
